facts.text: Wesleyan University does not include loans in undergraduate financial aid packages, covering 100% of remaining demonstrated need across tuition, housing, books, supplies, and personal expenses.
Wesleyan University features an open curriculum where General Education Expectations provide a framework for exploration instead of a rigid set of requirements.

sources.title: Our Open Curriculum | Academics - Wesleyan University

facts.text: All undergraduate students at Wesleyan University are required to live on campus for all four years.
